The Portugal Tax Relocation Checklist (2026)

RULES AS OF JULY 2026

Free download. One page, four stages, zero fluff — the steps that protect you from the most expensive expat tax mistakes, verified against Portugal's consolidated legislation.

What's inside

  1. Before you move — the 183-day rule as it's actually written (any 12-month window, non-consecutive days), the housing rule that can make you tax resident early, mapping your income sources, and why you should start a day-count log now.
  2. Your first weeks in Portugal — the NIF, the bank account, and the address paperwork that decides residency disputes later.
  3. The IFICI window — eligibility, the personal tests, and the hard 15 January registration deadline.
  4. Every year after — worldwide income, claiming treaty relief actively, and keeping your evidence file alive.
